findings: Full frames reviewed alongside class-mask overlays: masks follow capachos and preserve visible leaf/pole occlusion boundaries.
Near views show enlarged capachos and some edge truncation; middle and far views retain soil, sky and background plants.
Hard far cases contain a foreground neighbor obscuring target; retained. Distance bins refer to aim-point target only.
No visible systematic RGB-mask displacement or missing whole-class annotation in the reviewed samples.
Frozen plant/environment appearance remains approximate; no aesthetic or botanical changes made.
limits: 18 train/val full frames inspected, not every pixel of every frame.
No test-image visual selection, no assessment of detector performance before training.
No fully empty RGB views or tiles in this dataset; many background pixels but no explicit empty-frame negatives.
Small val instances may disappear under historical reduced mask validation; final metrics must use original native raster masks.
